0022600135.text: The 76ers (3-1, 1st in the Atlantic, 2nd in the East) head into this road game, their fifth of the season, after a 1-0 start away from home and a loss in their most recent game, while the Pacers (2-1, 5th in the East) are on a one-game winning streak and sit 1 game back in the Central. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), and Jabari Walker, Joel Embiid and VJ Edgecombe are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions; Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee) and Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the 76ers won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 105-94 win in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
